Hello, my name is Rajdeep. I live in a small village in Rajasthan. I had already decided that after 12th, I would go to the city for graduation. But before that, I wanted to prepare myself. So I thought of learning English. Everyone used to tell me that if you want to learn to speak English, you will have to join coaching, take daily classes, and without group discussion, you won't be able to speak. Now, there was no such coaching in the village. For that, I would have to go to the city, and I had decided that I would go to the city only after learning English. One day, I was studying on YouTube. There, I came to know about the English Seekho app. In this app, there are short 2-5 minute videos of experts, which are made in series form according to the level. I started from basic and read up to advanced level English. Whatever I learned, I practiced with the AI coach. AI is really a useful thing. It would catch my smallest mistake and correct it. The best thing is that you can chat with AI as long as you want. In just 1 to 2 months, I was ready to go to the city. English Seekho app has proved that if you have the desire to learn, you don't need any fancy coaching for it. Now even the villagers say, 'We acknowledge you, master, you did wonders.'
